messages.text: Hi, just a quick checkup as I've seen many people getting shipping number and delivery yet I still have received nothing sine this email 10 days ago so I'm not sure what "shortly"  is considered to be. Thanks for the follow up

Hi,

Thanks for checking in, and I'm sorry you've been left waiting for that shipping notice.

I'd like to give you a real answer, but your message didn't come through with an order attached, so I can't see which order this is yet. Could you reply with your order number (it looks like Shop····) and one detail from the order, such as the name it ships to or the postcode?

Once I have those, I'll tell you exactly where your order is. If it has shipped, I'll send the tracking. If it hasn't, I'll give you the date it ships.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi, here is the info, Order Shop···· and shipping is to postal code ····. Thanks for the follow up

Get Outlook for Android<https://aka.ms/AAb9ysg>

Hi,

Thanks for sending those details. You're right to ask, and I'm sorry "shortly" has turned into ten more days.

Your Harlo B30 is at our Canadian warehouse and already set aside for your order. It hasn't shipped because it's packed in the same box as your free Power K., and the Power K. isn't in stock there yet. The warehouse never sends half a box, so the Power K. is what's holding up your miner.

I can fix that by splitting the order. Your B30 would ship now, and the Power K. would follow in its own parcel as soon as it arrives. It costs you nothing, and each parcel gets its own tracking number by email.

Just reply "yes, split it" and I'll set it up. If you'd rather keep everything in one box, you don't need to do anything. Your order stays first in line and ships as soon as the Power K. comes in.

You can follow incoming stock at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
